text: This staff report is about a matter that Community Council has delegated authority from City Council to make a final decision. The purpose of this report is to obtain approval to install a "No Parking Anytime" regulation on the north and west sides of Ridgevalley Crescent, from a point 165 metres east of the south intersection of Ridgecross Road to a point 30 metres further east and north. This regulation will prohibit vehicles from parking in the area of the Toronto Water Pumping Station. This regulation will assist Toronto Water in maintaining access to their pumping station.

Etobicoke York Community Council: 1. Prohibited parking at all times on the north side of Ridgevalley Crescent, between a point 165 metres east of the south intersection of Ridgecross Road and a point 30 metres further east and north.
